name: nominal_sale_not_mover
why: A $1 deed (non-arm's-length, e.g. transfer into a trust) 22 days before as_of must NOT earn mover points — audited SALE_PRICE noise ($1/$100) is real in Ramsey data. Without this guard the door would score 100. Isolates the PRICE branch of the OR-rule; fixture 12 isolates the SALES_CODE branch.

evidence_must_exclude.reason: nominal transfer is not a household move

evidence_must_include.reason: SALE_PRICE=1 (<= $100) flags nominal transfer even with empty SALES_CODE; surfaced so a rep understands why the score is low despite a fresh deed
